_rule: Atlas v2.1 release checklist (author, 2026-10-14): every deliverable, where it must be (repo, S3, Zenodo), and whether it is required. CANON/v21_release.py checks each place by code and writes V21_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md; the Zenodo upload refuses while any required box is open. A Zenodo box is ticked only from the deposit's own file list after upload.
